biography:
I’m a commercially minded leader in the hyperscale infrastructure space, currently managing the delivery of a 100 MW data centre campus in the UK. My focus is on driving capital-efficient outcomes — ensuring complex, high-value projects are delivered with speed, certainty, and long-term value baked in for both investors and our customers.

My experience spans the full lifecycle: from early-stage development and capex strategy through to procurement, commercial execution, and operational readiness. I understand the pressure of aligning and managing delivery risk with investor expectations.

With the ever increasing use of AI, the incoming Neo-Cloud advancements, land and power restrictions across regions, I’m interested to see how investors, customers, our developer peers and supply chains flex to suit. 

I’m always looking to connect with others building or investing in digital infrastructure — whether that’s at asset, platform, or strategy level.
